newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net Upland sales of 70,300 running bales (RB) were 31 percent more than the previous week, but 9 percent less than the 4-week average.

The major increases were for Turkey (41,800 RB), China (11,300 RB), Indonesia (6,100 RB), and Guatemala (5,000 RB). Sales of 42,300 RB for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for South Korea (17,700 RB) and Japan (14,900 RB).

Exports of 130,100 RB exceeded the previous week by 14 percent, but were 8 percent below the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 65 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 23 percent; and West European, 12 percent.
